from pathlib import Path
work=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-rnd0/frozen/seen/play/users/u010/system/state/workspace')
programs=work/'programs'
programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_dividers = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    col_dividers = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]

    def spans(length, dividers):
        cuts = [-1] + dividers + [length]
        return [(cuts[i] + 1, cuts[i + 1]) for i in range(len(cuts) - 1)]

    row_spans = spans(h, row_dividers)
    col_spans = spans(w, col_dividers)
    tiles = [(r0, r1, c0, c1) for r0, r1 in row_spans for c0, c1 in col_spans
             if r0 < r1 and c0 < c1]
    cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if r not in row_dividers and c not in col_dividers]
    background = max(set(cells), key=cells.count)
    def score(tile):
        r0, r1, c0, c1 = tile
        return sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
    source_tile = max(tiles, key=score)
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = source_tile
    pattern = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for tr0, tr1 in row_spans:
        for tc0, tc1 in col_spans:
            if tr0 < tr1 and tc0 < tc1:
                for i, r in enumerate(range(tr0, tr1)):
                    for j, c in enumerate(range(tc0, tc1)):
                        out[r][c] = pattern[i][j]
    return out
'''
path=programs/'task-09e17784.py'
path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(path),'exec'),globals())
test=[[5,5,5],[5,5,5],[8,8,8],[7,7,5],[5,4,5]]
ans=transform(test)
print(ans)
